# Source-controlled dependency patches

Original copyright and complete upstream license texts accompany these checked-in patches.
The application license and existing attribution notices are unchanged.

- braces 3.0.3: [MIT](LICENSES/braces-3.0.3.txt). Adds bounded depth/cycle checks for parsed and externally supplied brace trees.
- node-forge 1.4.0: [BSD-3-Clause](LICENSES/node-forge-1.4.0.txt). Rejects nested RSA DigestInfo AlgorithmIdentifier parameters while preserving valid signatures.

The full original node-forge dual-license text is retained; the BSD-3-Clause option is selected.
[Provenance](patch-attribution.json) records official npm tarball integrity, original file/license hashes and patch hashes.
Null denotes a locally added file. Recheck provenance and run the existing dependency regressions when patches change.
This is patch-source attribution, not a complete distribution SBOM or proof of all dependency compliance.
